verdict.rationale: Turn-taking and endpointing are a core, applicable axis for a voice-agent platform like Bolna. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions end-of-turn detection, endpointing models, VAD configuration or interruption handling. The speech-to-speech mode (bolna-docs-7) and language auto-switching (bolna-docs-35) do not address turn detection, so absence of evidence yields none.
